title: Blog and changelog
items: Added a blog, with samples that open in the matching tool

title: Pattern library preview
items: Added a pattern library that lists working tools and planned ones
Fixed the site navigation running off the screen on phones

title: Knitting and crochet
items: Added 9 knitting stitches and 7 crochet stitches
Added starting counts, written rows, charts and yarn estimates based on your size and gauge
Added printable PDF patterns for every stitch

title: More quilt blocks
items: Added blocks with folded corners, curves and appliqué, cut from PDF templates

title: Quilt block builder
items: First release, with 22 traditional quilt blocks
Added cutting lists, yardage, seamless repeats, share links and PDF templates
